author: Claude (Opus 5.5) in the owner's interactive Claude Code session, 2026-11-10
mode: claude_code_session (one-time interactive response; not an unattended or autonomous agent)

claims.text: 001 (late-day intraday momentum) lost 1.41% after base costs and 2.99% at stress costs on 2016-2021 development data.

The loss existed before costs: the zero-cost re-run still lost 0.50% and the mean move per trade was about -1.2 bp; the morning signal had essentially no relation to the last 30 minutes (correlation +0.02).
It ranked at about the 10th percentile of random long/flat entry, so random days did better; it failed rules 1, 2, 4 and 5 and passed only the drawdown rule.
The implementation was independently recomputed with 0 mismatches, so the failure is evidence against the hypothesis, not a software defect.
002 (opening-range breakout) earned a small gross edge (+$1,166 on 1,058 trades, about +2.3 bp per trade) that the base round-trip cost of 2.3 bp consumed almost exactly.
Net was -0.014% at base costs and -2.19% at stress costs (6.6 bp round trip): the verdict depended on unmeasured cost assumptions.

It ranked at the 83rd percentile of the random-entry screen (95th required), lost $1,103.73 without its 10 largest winners, and one predeclared variation (midpoint stop) was negative; it failed D1, D4, D5 and D6.
Reopening 002 with cheaper costs or promoting its best variation would be after-the-fact rescue, which the predeclared rules forbid; both experiments are closed.

decision.recommendation: Do not start a third strategy experiment now. Make resolving the quote-data semantics the next research step: the owner sends the prepared Alpaca support request (questions A1-A5) and research waits for written answers before any further data spend or hypothesis test.
alternatives: Pre-register a stress-day spread stratum now (dates chosen by a public event calendar, no returns), accepting it stays PROVISIONAL until A1-A5 are answered.
Run the remaining 18 pilot sessions (cheap, but the pilot itself expects little new information from more calm days).
Adopt a minimum-edge rule for future specs (expected gross edge must clear the 6.6 bp stress round trip with margin) - a process change needing no data.
Start a new hypothesis on 2016-2021 SPY - not recommended: the exploration log shows late-day, breakout and down-morning ideas already seen, and both failures hit the same cost wall.
evidence_needed: Written Alpaca answers to A1 (timestamp clock), A2 (condition '?'), A3 (NBBO construction), A4 (locked/crossed), A5 (filtering/corrections) for 2016-2021.
For a stress stratum: a public, return-free date rule fixed in a pre-registration before any download.
For any future hypothesis: a stated expected gross edge per trade above the stress round-trip cost, and data not already used by 001/002.
